item.title: MARK LUCAS: Why veterans need a VA bill of rights now
item.description: We deserve an agency that puts us first. The Veterans Bill of Rights will protect veterans from bureaucracy, neglect, and indifference.

item.title: French judge under fire after team USA denied Gold in Olympic ice dance
item.description: She gave the Americans 129.74, making her the only judge not to score them above 130.

item.title: UK to allow 'social transitioning' to the opposite sex for primary school students as young as 5
item.description: The new document states that primary schools should exercise “particular caution,” but says support for full social transition may be agreed “very rarely.”

item.title: London Mayor Sadiq Khan praises launch of British Muslim Trust to track 'Islamophobia'
item.description: Khan referenced racism he said he experienced growing up in London in the 1970s and warned that “extremists are trying to turn back the clock on the progress we’ve made.”

item.title: SOAD TABRIZI: Trump's FTC demands answers from WPATH, American Academy of Pediatrics, on support and advocacy for trans treatment
item.description: Now, the FTC amplifies this – potentially unraveling a scheme where memberships and provider lists hype demand while hiding horrors. WPATH's SOC-8 is a sham: no age minimums for interventions – despite "very low" evidence ratings on most recommendations.

item.title: 23-year-old French nationalist brutally beaten by Antifa thugs while protecting women's rights activists from harm, expected to die
item.description: "His attackers were hooded and armed with reinforced gloves and pepper spray, leaving little doubt as to the premeditated nature of their attack."

item.title: EU Parliament adopts resolution declaring 'trans women as women'
item.description: An additional resolution, which would have said that only biological women can become pregnant, was rejected.

item.title: Revealed: Russian opposition leader Alexei Navalny was murdered in prison with dart frog poison in 2024
item.description: "Epibatidine is a toxin found in poison dart frogs in South America."

item.title: French nationalist brutally beaten by Antifa thugs dies after protecting women’s rights activists
item.description: The man, identified as Quentin, was reportedly part of an informal security group defending a pro-women protest outside a political conference near Sciences Po in Lyon.

item.title: MP Rupert Lowe launches ‘Restore Britain’ party for 'full-scale restoration' of UK
item.description: "I simply could no longer justify asking you to place your faith in a system that has repeatedly shown it cannot - or will not - fix itself.”
